w2k.command.experiments.instructions: To enable/disable experiments, you need to add %s (with comma separated experiment names appended afterward) to your game's Java launch options. For more information, please consult the W2K wiki at %s.
w2k.experiment.command_line_laf_override: Instructs the Blackbox to override the theme it uses when launching the game with one defined in the command-line Java option "me.videogamesm12.w2k.blackbox_theme" if set.
w2k.experiment.default_laf_based_on_syst: Changes the behavior of the Blackbox when setting up a fresh installation to use a theme based on the system you're using and how it's configured instead of defaulting to a Material Dark theme.
w2k.experiment.experiments_existence_ack: Adds commands and other additional interactive features related to W2K's experiments.
